methods.name: Closest pairs
methods.plain: Pick the two series that moved most alike in the past and trade when they drift apart.

methods.name: Cointegration
methods.plain: Pick two series tied together over time, so their gap keeps coming back to normal.

methods.name: Moving hedge ratio
methods.plain: Like cointegration, but how much of one leg balances the other updates every week.

methods.name: Factor leftovers
methods.plain: Remove what the whole market does and trade what is left when it strays.

leaderboard.name: Cointegration, 49 industries
leaderboard.description: Pairs of industries whose returns tie together over time, traded when the gap is wide.
leaderboard.verdict_plain: The Sharpe looks fine, but after counting 9 tries it could be luck.

leaderboard.name: Closest pairs, 49 industries
leaderboard.description: The industries that moved most alike in the past year, traded when they drift apart.
leaderboard.verdict_plain: It loses money once trading costs are counted.

leaderboard.name: Moving hedge ratio, G10 currencies
leaderboard.description: Currency pairs with a hedge ratio that updates every week.
leaderboard.verdict_plain: Likely real after counting 12 tries, but it earns little.

leaderboard.description: What is left of each industry after the main market factors, traded when it strays.
